title: capsella bursa-pastoris subsp. occidentalis
intro: Capsella bursa-pastoris subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as Western shepherd's purse, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae) that is native to Western North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and aiding in wound healing due to its ability to stop bleeding. The therapeutic actions of Western shepherd's purse include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hemostatic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
